description: Complete system synchronization and review-only evidence return after Universal Bridge data or actions are used.

hooks.prompt: If a successful `SDA bridge --channel workbuddy read` or `action` command occurred in this conversation, require the corresponding successful `sync` when an analysis result exists and always require a later successful `evidence` call with the same exact system and operation ID. Otherwise return {"ok":false,"reason":"请先按 Universal Bridge Skill 将结果同步到准确系统，并回传有界、待复核的操作证据；不要上传对话全文、原始文件或原始数据行。"}. If no Bridge data/action was used, or the required calls succeeded, return {"ok":true}.
